notes.title: Urgent update for 'Call Me Hero'
Call Me Hero "September 24th Update Log
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from netizens and players, we have made the following updates and fixes:

1. Add a "skip" button in the prologue, and players can long press the E key to skip the video they have watched;
[b](This feature is a beta test and will only appear in the prologue. We will continuously optimize it based on feedback from everyone until it is fully updated.)[/b]

Chapter 2: Lin Feng's Inner Burial Ground solves the problem of players stepping out of the map and slightly enhances the intensity of nightmares;

3. Solved the problem of UI overlap in the trial of Su Ziming in Chapter 4;


A letter to players
Dear player,
Firstly, we would like to express our deepest gratitude and apologies. Thank you for choosing to embark on this gaming journey with us, and we sincerely apologize for any shortcomings in the game.
The post game development team of "Call Me Hero" was a small team of only three members, who, with their love and dreams for the game, made their first attempt at making a game. Like many novice creators, we have encountered many challenges in technology, design, and even game balance. But please believe that every challenge is a ladder for our growth.
Each of your suggestions is our driving force for progress. We promise to listen carefully and analyze every feedback carefully, whether it is about optimizing game performance, improving plot depth, or even fine-tuning the interface. We will do our best to make the game more perfect.

The most criticized issue among players is that the favorability index is too high, causing them to get stuck in the game progress. This is the result of our dozens of game tests. In the game settings, favorability can be improved in various ways. To address this, we have launched a quick pass strategy. Here is the video link for players to quickly complete the game. Once again, we sincerely apologize to the players who have been troubled by game development issues.

https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1dAsSeHEHW/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0&vd_source=be2f0e36edffc84eb08c1a0f530ab0cc


And regarding the Nightmare Mode and subsequent DLC, we have decided to meet everyone in the form of free updates. We deeply understand that it is your support and patience that gives us the courage to continue moving forward. Therefore, we hope to give back to everyone's love in this way and make the game our common pride.
Thank you again for your tolerance and understanding. Please believe that we will prove through our actions that your choice is not wrong. Let's witness the growth of the game together, and also witness the growth of our team.
Starting from the heart, heading towards the dream.

Call Me Hero Development Team
2024.9.24
